comment: Campaign reports whose target app lives in THIS repository, so their originalText/mutatedText is our own MIT-licensed source rather than a third party's. The 2026-08-09 ruling is about third-party source; redacting our own would destroy the artifact for no gain. Every entry is checked mechanically by scripts/redact-campaign-report.test.ts: the projectDir must exist and every mutant's file must resolve inside it, so 'first-party' is proven rather than asserted. Anything not listed here must be redacted.

reports.reason: The gift card demo app, written for this repository and published under its MIT licence. Kept unredacted on purpose: it is the sample report the docs point at, so `lethal explain report.json --top 10` can be run with no server, and the survivors' originalText/mutatedText are the whole point of showing it.

The credit limit demo app, written for this repository and published under its MIT licence. Kept unredacted for the same reason as the gift card demo: it is the report its README quotes mutant by mutant (M0015, M0019, M0025), and redacting the originalText those ids refer to would leave the README pointing at nothing.
